style_context: Plant anatomy, pollination, soils, crop science, propagation, and field botany

images.description: Clean educational diagram of a dissected flowering plant arranged on a plain white background, showing the whole plant structure and major parts clearly separated and labeled: roots, stem, leaf, petals, sepals, stamens, pistil, fruit, and seeds; realistic botanical colors, simple horizontal labels only, no branding or decorative text
images.value: Shows the spatial arrangement and visual differences among the major flowering-plant parts in one view, relationships that text alone cannot teach quickly
